source.methods: Accepted manuscript sections3-5; K>=90% variance; rolling S=182/365; score Ljung-Box5% then AR1 otherwise0; predicted minimum then later maximum

replication_scope: Explicit component adaptation of published Fmean/FPAR methods, not exact full-paper replication. No author execution code obtained from the institutional copies and scoped title/code search. Does not establish absence of any code elsewhere.
source_ambiguities: Manuscript says290 daily5m observations;24h has288 nonoverlapping5m intervals. Use288 actual minute-open grid observations00:00 through23:55 UTC; disclose difference.

Score Ljung-Box lag length and AR1 estimator not explicitly fixed in reviewed model section. The separate curve-dependence section reports1/5/10/20; use these as disclosed sensitivity lags, not assert exact score-test original settings.
No source-specific hard stop,TP1,initialR or native urgent-warning contract. These gates remain unverified.

data.venues: Existing checksum-verified Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual1m and actual funding, not Bitstamp source or LBank fills
data.training_input: All2022-Sep2026 data have already been viewed in other research; reused/exploratory, no untouched claims. Keep all existing quarantine masks; current raw-trade audit released none.
data.day_curve: 100*log(original1m open at each5min grid /day00:00 open),288 samples. Complete original1440minutes and no quarantined minute required for a valid training day; never interpolate.
data.window: Previous S valid observed UTC days ending before forecast day; retained dates and calendar span saved. Validity of training days is known before forecast. Do not select target-day predictions using future returns or later quality facts.
data.target_quality: Generate and save prediction before inspecting target-day prices. If required execution/path data missing, keep forecast as unevaluable, record unknown PnL; do not assignzero or artificially liquidate.

models.fmean: Rolling mean curve for each window, published benchmark;2variants.
models.fpar: Centered empirical discrete FPCA on rolling training matrix, retain smallestK explaining>=90% variance. For each retained score series Ljung-Box p<.05 fits AR1 by OLS with intercept, otherwise predicted score0. Add predicted scores times fitted bases to training mean. Recompute bases and tests causally each day. Zero total variance returns mean.
models.multiplicity: 8FPAR+2Fmean variants, all reported together. No best-lag/window cherry-pick or label research-selected winner independent. No coefficient clipping or return-driven tuning.

trade_rule.direction: 1x long/cash return proxy; no short/order/account access
trade_rule.entry_exit: Before target day, fix earliest predicted global-min grid time, then earliest predicted maximum in its inclusive suffix. If exit<=entry, no trade. Fill both scheduled times at first original minute open60seconds later, before UTC midnight. No overnight position.
trade_rule.costs: Per side fee0.0006 and adverse slippage0.0002; charge adverse actual funding only while held, do not credit favorable funding. Repeat identical signals at2x fees,slippage,funding charges. Source fee0.03% not treated as native LBank cost.

required_output: Full and per-year net results for every variant and both cost levels; calendar coverage/unknown outcomes; cost-free results separately
